Privacy Policy for Stat Blitz

Last updated: September 21, 2026

Thank you for playing Stat Blitz. This policy explains what information the app collects, how it's used, and your rights regarding that information.

Summary

Stat Blitz is a sports trivia game. It does not require you to create an account, does not collect personal information, and does not use third-party advertising or analytics services.

Information We Collect

We do not collect personal information. Stat Blitz does not ask for your name, email address, phone number, or any other personally identifying information.

Gameplay data stored on your device. Your progress, settings (difficulty level, Hard Mode, category preferences), daily streak, and best times are stored locally on your device. This information never leaves your device and is not accessible to us or any third party.

Information We Do Not Collect

  • Location data
  • Contacts, photos, or other device content
  • Advertising identifiers
  • Analytics or usage tracking data
  • Any data through third-party SDKs

Children's Privacy

Stat Blitz does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone, including children under 13. Because the app collects no personal information from any user, it does not present the privacy concerns associated with apps that do.

Third-Party Services

Stat Blitz does not integrate third-party advertising networks, analytics platforms, or social media SDKs.

Changes to This Policy

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted here with a revised "Last updated" date.

Contact

Questions about this policy or the app can be directed to: jpgsportsbiz@gmail.com

This policy applies to the Stat Blitz mobile application and website.
